definitions.explanation: A work into which great effort, time, and skill have been poured. Used for art, literature, film, academic papers, and other creative or intellectual endeavors.

examples.japanese: これは{彼|かれ}の{力作|りきさく}だ。
{三|さん}{年|ねん}かけて{完成|かんせい}させた{力作|りきさく}だ。
examples.english: It's a painstaking work that took three years to complete.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{映画祭|えいがさい}には{世界中|せかいじゅう}から{力作|りきさく}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Ambitious works from around the world gathered at this film festival.

notes:
{力作|りきさく} refers to a work into which great effort and dedication have been poured. It is always complimentary.

FORMS:
{力|りき} (effort, power) + {作|さく} (work, creation). Emphasizes the effort invested, not necessarily the artistic quality of the result.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {渾身|こんしん}の{力作|りきさく}: a work of one's whole heart and soul
- {力作|りきさく}ぞろい: a lineup of masterpieces
- {大|だい}{力作|りきさく}: a great ambitious work
- {力作|りきさく}を{発表|はっぴょう}する: to present a major work

USAGE:
Applied to art, literature, film, music, academic papers, and even ambitious cooking or craft projects. Often used in reviews, praise, and introductions of creative works.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {傑作|けっさく}: masterpiece (emphasizes quality/brilliance)
- {名作|めいさく}: masterpiece, classic (emphasizes lasting reputation)
- {力作|りきさく}: painstaking work (emphasizes effort invested)
